ACTION.NAME: CHECK_IF_USERID_EXISTS
ACTION.STATEMENT: select case when exists(select 1 from [User] where User_ID=@UserId) then 'Y' else 'N' end as ValidUserId

ACTION.NAME: READ_USER_ACCESS
ACTION.STATEMENT: Select f_ubuip.PK_Passwords,f_ubuip.User_ID,f_ubuip.First_Name+' '+f_ubuip.Last_Name as UserName,f_ubuip.First_Name,f_ubuip.Last_Name,f_ubuip.User_Password,f_ubuip.Access_Level_PK,f_ubuip.Spec_Write,'' as Email, STUFF(( SELECT ', ' + ru.RoleId FROM [Manufacturing].[dbo].[RoleUser] ru WHERE ru.UserId = f_ubuip.User_ID FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') AS Roles, 'Active' as Status FROM [Manufacturing].[dbo].[UDF_UserByUserId](@UserId) f_ubuip

ACTION.NAME: CHECK_USER_ACCESS
ACTION.STATEMENT: Select f_ubuip.PK_Passwords,f_ubuip.User_ID,f_ubuip.First_Name+' '+f_ubuip.Last_Name as UserName,f_ubuip.First_Name,f_ubuip.Last_Name,f_ubuip.User_Password,f_ubuip.Access_Level_PK,f_ubuip.Spec_Write,'' as Email, STUFF(( SELECT ', ' + ru.RoleId FROM [Manufacturing].[dbo].[RoleUser] ru WHERE ru.UserId = f_ubuip.User_ID FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') AS Roles, 'Active' as Status FROM [Manufacturing].[dbo].[UDF_UserByUserIdPassword](@UserId, @Password) f_ubuip
